# 1.26.1 — quoting a list or a table keeps it in one piece

A small fix right after 1.26.0, for the new **Reply** feature.

Settings, keys and conversations from earlier versions are read as they are.

## What was wrong

When the selected passage of a reply contained a **bulleted or numbered list** or a **table**,
the quote came apart. Every list marker ended up on a line of its own, away from its text:

```
-
open the firewall
-
add a rule
```

instead of

```
- open the firewall
- add a rule
```

Table cells were split onto separate lines the same way. The quote plate above the input field and
the card above a sent message show the first line of the quote, so a quote that started with a list
item showed a lonely "-" there. The model received the same broken lines — the words were all
there, but the structure was not.

Plain text, code blocks and formulas were quoted correctly and are not affected. Nothing was lost:
messages were sent and answered as usual.

## What changed

A list item or a table cell now continues its line after the marker or the separator, so a quoted
list reads as a list and a quoted table row as a row.

## File

`Amarin-Admin-AI-v1.26.1-win-x64.exe` — a single file, nothing to unpack.
